statusDefinitions.as-cited: Citation copied as printed in the L1 decision; the cited decision itself was not read.
statusDefinitions.read: The source document was opened and quoted.

precedents.citation: LCX AG v 1.274M U.S. Dollar Coin, 2022 NY Slip Op 32834[U]
precedents.point: Service on anonymous defendants by an airdropped token linking to a website with the papers.
precedents.note: Citation form as printed on p.4 of the L1 decision. The OAG memorandum cites the same matter as LCX AG v. John Doe Nos. 1-25, No. 154644/2022.

precedents.citation: Meghji v Wallet Owner (In re Celsius Network LLC), 666 BR 28 [Bankr SD NY 2024]
precedents.point: Service by airdropped NFT into crypto wallets of unidentifiable owners.

precedents.citation: People v Unknown Parties in Ownership and/or Control of Digital Wallet Addresses, Sup Ct, Queens County, Index No. 700647/2025
precedents.point: Service by airdropping NFTs hyperlinked to a website with the papers to three wallet addresses (CPLR 308(5)); service complete on filing of the affidavit.
precedents.note: Signed 2025-06-09, entered 2025-06-11 (NYSCEF 21). A Slip Op number was not confirmed (nycourts.gov reporter returned 403 on 2026-10-25), so it is cited by Index No. only.
